# Dormimanía

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Mexican mattress retailer based in Guadalajara with branches there and an online store on Shopify. Its shipping policy states delivery to 95 percent of the country subject to carrier coverage, with carrier-branch pickup (ocurre) where the carrier has no home coverage.
